NameMaxLength.Name: Maximum weapon name length
NameMaxLength.Hint: Longer names are shortened with “…” in the Combat Tracker.

WeaponsOwnersOnly.Name: Weapons visible to owners only
WeaponsOwnersOnly.Hint: Enabled: only the actor's owners see its equipped weapons in the Combat Tracker. Disabled: everyone sees them (only owners can roll).

CanvasFollowsSelection.Name: Canvas targets follow the selected token
CanvasFollowsSelection.Hint: When you select a token, the targets shown on the canvas become the ones stored for that token (the same ones the Combat Tracker shows). Disabled: the canvas does not change when selecting.

ZWH_ADDONS.NoTokenOnCanvas: Cannot target: the token is not on the scene being viewed.
